title: CRLR/325/2013 of Omkar Nath Dubey Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports, orders or

Registrar's order with
Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CRLR No.325 of 2013
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, Advocate for the
revisionist, through video conferencing.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, A.G.A. with Ms. S.B. Dobhal, B.H. for the
State.
3. There is no representation for the private respondents.
4. Vide order dated 21.10.2024, learned counsel for the
revisionists was granted ten days' time to serve upon the un-served
respondents and the matter was directed to be listed on 23.12.2024.
5. From the record, it transpires that no steps have been taken
by learned counsel for the revisionists.
6. Learned counsel for the revisionists submitted that he has
got no instructions and nobody is turning up.
7. Accordingly criminal revision is dismissed for non
compliance of the order dated 23.12.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.03.2025
SK
